text: As a proud South El Monte resident for 53 years, it has been an honor to serve as your Valle Lindo School District Trustee. I am committed to putting students first, supporting our dedicated teachers and staff, maintaining safe schools, and ensuring every child receives the high-quality education they deserve.

Throughout my term, I have led with integrity, transparency, and fiscal responsibility. I proudly championed the effort to place our district's first school bond before voters, creating an opportunity to improve and modernize our schools for future generations. Together, we have strengthened our district's financial stability, expanded community partnerships, and continued investing in opportunities that help every student succeed. I have also built partnerships with local trade organizations, businesses, and community leaders to expand educational opportunities and valuable resources for our students.

Beyond the Board, I have spent many years volunteering with local wrestling clubs, the El Monte/South El Monte Jets youth football and cheer organization, and our local Little League programs because I believe strong communities build strong schools.
I respectfully ask for your vote so we can continue moving Valle Lindo forward and preparing every student for a bright future.

text: a lifelong resident of South El Monte. As a High School Counselor, I see the impact of education daily. My educational background includes a B.A. in Psychology with a Minor in Education from UCLA and a M.A. in Counseling, Pupil Services Credential, Child Welfare & Attendance Credential and a Behavior Intervention Case Management Certification from CSULA.

Our public schools are the heart of our community. Every child in the Valle Lindo School District deserves a high-quality education in a safe, supportive environment. My vision centers on four key pillars:

Giving families and educators a real seat at the table where their voices are heard.
-

Providing access to a rigorous curriculum, modern technology, expanded STEM and arts programs.
-

Empowering educators with resources and professional development to thrive in the classroom.
-
Having an educational environment that is well-maintained and built for the 21st century.

Strong schools build strong communities. I pledge to listen to parents, collaborate with staff, and keep our students' best interests at the forefront. I would be honored to earn your vote and help shape the next generation of leaders.
